data.name: Aqil
data.gender_notes: Aqil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aqil is a noble Arabic name meaning 'wise', 'intelligent', or 'one who understands'. It comes from the root 'A-Q-L' (ع-ق-ل), which relates to intellect, reason, and maturity. It reflects a person who acts with knowledge and sound judgment. The name Aqil carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent, Sensible” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Aqil usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent, sensible and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Denotes one who seeks knowledge, reflects with clarity, and uses intellect to guide himself and others.
data.etymology: Aqil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent, Sensible.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aqil total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: عقيل
in_arabic.meaning: عقيل يعني الشخص العاقل والحكيم جدا
in_arabic.long_meaning: عقيل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الشخص العاقل والحكيم جدا، المشتق من الفعل عَقَلَ يَعقِلُ عَقْلاً فهو عاقل، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة آية 231، ويعتبر من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية لما يحمله من صفات حميدة.

in_urdu.name: عقیل
in_urdu.meaning: عقیل مطلب ہے عقلمند اور حكيم شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: عقیل ایک مسلم نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے عقلمند اور حكيم شخص۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جہاں اس کا مطلب ہے 'عقل رکھنے والا' یا 'بुद्धیمان'۔ اسلامی تقویم میں اس نام کی شخصیت کو بہت اہمیت حاصل ہے کیونکہ یہ حکمت و دانائی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अक़ील
in_hindi.meaning: अक़ील का अर्थ है बुद्धिमान और समझदार
in_hindi.long_meaning: अक़ील एक इस्लामी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमान और समझदार। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जहां इसका अर्थ है 'बुद्धिमत्ता रखने वाला' या 'ज्ञानवान'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम बुद्धिमत्ता और समझदारी के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عقیل
in_pashto.meaning: عقیل د عقلمند او دانا سړي معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عقیل د پښتو ژبې يو نوم دے چې د عقلمند او دانا سړي معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دے چيرته چې د 'عقل' کلمه د پوهې او حکمت څخه مشتق شوې ده. په پښتنو او افغانانو کې دا نوم د حکمت او پوهې د نښې په توګه کارول کيږي.

in_english.name: Aqil
in_english.meaning: Aqil means intelligent, wise, and knowledgeable person
in_english.long_meaning: Aqil is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'intelligent', 'wise', or 'knowledgeable'. It is derived from the Arabic verb 'aqala', which means 'to be intelligent' or 'to understand'. The name Aqil appears in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Baqarah verse 231, emphasizing its significance in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes wisdom, intellect, and good judgment, making it a highly regarded name in Muslim cultures worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aqil is cherished in Arab and Islamic communities, where intelligence and wisdom are highly valued traits. Aqil can be a source of family pride, as it is given to children who are expected to grow up and contribute to society as wise and intelligent individuals. It is also a name that evokes a sense of admiration and respect, as people associate wisdom and intelligence with knowledge, power, and success.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, wisdom and knowledge are considered essential to living a righteous and fulfilling life. Aqil is a reminder of the importance of using one's intellect and reasoning ability to seek knowledge and understanding of both the physical and spiritual worlds. It is a name that embodies the belief in the Qur'an that "Allah will exalt those who believe among you and those who have knowledge to degrees" (Quran 58:11). By striving to be wise and intelligent, individuals can draw closer to Allah and fulfill their potential as human beings.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Aqil in Arabic means 'intelligent' or 'wise'. It symbolizes the innate human capacity for understanding and making logical decisions, often associated with the heart (Qalb) and intellect (Aql) in Islamic teachings. It is a reminder to seek knowledge and wisdom, and to use our God-given intellect to make wise choices in life.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aqil ibn Abi Talib was a cousin and companion of Prophet Muhammad. The name Aqil carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Aqil was a prominent figure in early Islamic history and is revered in Islamic tradition.
